r1.name: Open-source DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO or Elk)

access.notes: Must support LSDA total-energy calculations. Pseudopotentials / muffin‑tin setups should correspond to LSDA (Perdew–Wang).

r1.notes: The paper used FP‑LMTO; any open‑source alternative that yields comparable LSDA total energies is acceptable.

r2.notes: Used for E(V) fitting, elastic constant extraction, sound‑velocity calculation, and implementation of the quasi‑harmonic Debye model.
